bug_info.bug_desc: In firmware-override entropy-insertion mode, when firmware deasserts fw_ov_sha3_start while the preconditioning/write-data path is still full, the design raises es_fw_ov_disable_alert as a recoverable alert. However, the old RTL only raised the alert; it did not also suppress the corrupted SHA-3 conditioner outputs that can result from this firmware misuse. The corruption can affect up to two conditioned seeds, and those corrupted seeds were still allowed through main_stage_push into the esfinal FIFO, where firmware or the hardware interface could consume them. The missing behavior is the cross-cycle control state needed to remember the corruption event and drop the following two conditioned outputs.
bug_info.fix_hint: Add a 2-bit corruption-tracking state, reset to zero, that is loaded to 2'b11 when es_fw_ov_disable_alert occurs in conditioned mode. While this state is non-zero and the module is not in bypass mode, gate main_stage_push so no seed is written to the esfinal FIFO. Advance the shift register on each raw main-stage push so exactly two corrupted conditioner outputs are discarded before normal pushing resumes.
